newsitem.title: ERITREA: Congo's Kabila in Eritrea on state visit.
newsitem.headline: Congo's Kabila in Eritrea on state visit.

text.p: President Laurent Kabila of the Democratic Republic of the Congo arrived in Eritrea on Wednesday for a three-day visit, the official Eritrea News Agency reported.
It gave no further details on Kabila's visit to the Red Sea state.

Kabila took power in May after a seven-month military campaign that ended the 32-year rule of Mobutu Sese Seko, who went into exile from the country formerly known as Zaire. Kabila has pledged reform after decades of economic mismanagement under Mobutu.
